events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of the King of Rock 'n' Roll.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost him, Elvis Presley's influence on music and culture remains unmatched. What's your favourite track from The King?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: The hip-hop icon was fatally shot in Las Vegas 30 years ago today.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Impact
angles.copy: Three decades on, the music and message of Tupac Shakur continue to resonate. His lyrical genius left an indelible mark on hip-hop and beyond.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Marking 56 years since the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, the world lost a true visionary. Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with a guitar, leaving a legacy that still inspires.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' 57 years ago today in 1969.

angles.name: That Iconic Crossing
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, that music – it's still as fresh as ever.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon Turns 75
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the formidable Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting have powered The Pretenders for decades.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic former Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star at 54
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to Liam Gallagher, whose unmistakable swagger and vocals defined a generation. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Imagine's Release Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal solo album 'Imagine' 51 years ago in 1975.

angles.name: Lennon's Timeless Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that continues to inspire hope and peace around the world.

events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, 25 years ago in 2001.

angles.name: The Device That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago, this little device changed how we listened to music forever. The click wheel, the white headphones – pure nostalgia.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating the enduring legacy of the James Bond film franchise.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, 007 has been entertaining us for decades. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend at 87
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, known as 'The White Album', 58 years ago in 1968.

angles.name: A Double Dose of Genius
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. Its eclectic mix proved their incredible range. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. His legacy continues to rock us.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' 61 years ago in 1965.

angles.name: The Soul of The Beatles
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a pivotal shift in their sound and pop music history.
